name: Riley
goal: Riley wants to find a reliable and efficient flight to Stockholm that fits their budget and allows them to start their trip on a positive note.
backstory: Riley has been planning a trip to Stockholm for months and is particularly interested in visiting the Vasa Museum, so they want to book a flight that arrives early in the morning to make the most of their day. They've had a bad experience with layovers in the past, which made them miss a connecting flight. Riley tends to research extensively before making travel decisions.

name: Quinn
goal: Quinn hopes to help Riley find a flight that meets their needs while also considering the possibility of joining them for part of the trip.
backstory: Quinn has traveled with Riley before and knows how much they value their alone time, but Quinn is also excited about the prospect of exploring Stockholm together. Quinn recently heard about a new airline that offers affordable direct flights to Stockholm, but they're worried that it might not be as comfortable as other airlines. Quinn often thinks out loud when discussing travel plans.

name: Jordan
goal: Jordan aims to provide Riley with a range of well-researched flight options that balance cost, convenience, and comfort, while also being mindful of their own time constraints as a helper.
backstory: Jordan has experience booking flights for group trips and is familiar with the various airlines that operate out of their local airport. Jordan recently discovered a travel rewards program that could help Riley save money on their flight, but they're concerned that it might require them to fly into a different airport than they originally planned. Jordan tends to approach travel planning in a methodical and organized way.
